title: Render the daily brief on the operator's page (dashboard SPA)
note: SPLIT OUT OF A3 AND DISPATCHED 2026-09-21, the hour A3a merged (9751e17) so the lane builds against a REAL contract rather than a promised one. Repo: benbaichmankass/ict-trader-dashboard. [!] THIS IS THE HALF THAT CLOSES A7, and nothing else does. A3a's route renders the brief live, but reaching it still requires someone to CHOOSE to call it — which is reason (5) in plan § 3b verbatim, the failure that killed DUE.md. A7 closes when section 0 and the unrouted count are on the page the operator already opens. [!] LANE GIVEN THE MERGED CONTRACT rather than left to re-derive it: GET /api/bot/work/brief's envelope, and the three properties that must survive the render — `present:false` carries a REASON and must show as a stated gap not a blank panel; `inputs` ships a three-way read state per source and must not be collapsed; `coverageComplete` is false and the page must say so. [!] AND THE 47 KB PROBLEM: the brief measured 47,604 chars against 11 items and gets worse at A8's ~1,150. The lane is told section 0 and the section-5 unrouted count must be visible WITHOUT scrolling, the rest may collapse, and any truncation must print its count beside it. The store-side fix is E14 and is explicitly NOT this lane's. [!] IT CANNOT ESTABLISH THE CLOSING OBSERVATION ITSELF — 'the page renders correctly' needs a human on a real browser (headless against the deployed Pages URL fails from a sandbox, measured 2026-09-11). The lane can establish that the DEPLOY CARRIED THE CODE, and was told to do that with a positive control and a negative control rather than trusting a green pages.yml. [!] DONE 2026-09-21 ON THE CLOSING OBSERVATION, which this lane correctly said it could not make itself: the operator loaded the live Workflow page and section 0 was rendering there, with the read-state band intact (MANDATES: ABSENT separate from PIPELINE: READ).
